# Synthetic Git fixture contract

## Purpose

Exercise the public contract validator on disposable files.

## Invocation

Declared command: `bash capability/tool/tool-git-evidence/scripts/git-evidence.sh`.
Installed relative executable: `scripts/git-evidence.sh`.

## Authority

Read-only, offline fixture observations.

## Output

Emit JSON with the declared result shape.

## Failure and evidence

Report invalid input or unavailable fixture data.
